text:
chris: CI microbench failed on PR #14400 — kv_coldpath_bench exceeded threshold on tail latency. Failing job: https://ci.redwood/ci/14400 :exclamation:
perfbot: CI job kv_coldpath_bench (microbench) — status: failed
  baseline: 12.3 ms
  current: 14.5 ms
  delta: +2.2 ms (+17.9%)  (threshold: 10%)
  job: https://ci.redwood/ci/14400/logs
ben: ack. rough spike, can someone bisect the merge range?
chris: starting quick bisect now, will post results.
perfbot: note: PR 14388 (merged ~3h ago) touched runtime/batcher and runtime/prefetch heuristics.
maria: fwiw i ran a local microbench with --perf-alloc and captured flamegraph: https://s3.redwood/prof/14400/flame.svg
  flamegraph snippet:
  - batcher::flush_if_needed (43%)
  - kernel_selector::score_models (18%)
  - prefetch::maybe_issue (12%)
  looks like more time spent in flush path + selector scoring.
david: KV metrics for the same workload from canary: kv_cache_hitrate 0.83 -> 0.62, kv_evictions/sec jump 8x. that would explain coldpath activity.
anya: that matches the adapt-prefetch change in PR 14388 — it issues more aggressive prefetch when seq_len>512. maybe we're over-prefetching and evicting useful prefixes.
ben: bisect finished quickly:
  $ git bisect start
  $ git bisect bad HEAD
  $ git bisect good v2.12.3
  first bad commit: abc1234 runtime: adapt-prefetch: tune window and heuristics (PR 14388)
chris: confirmed locally by reverting that commit — microbench latency returns to baseline (12.4 ms).
maria: profiling diff after revert shows batcher flush time back down to 22% and selector costs reduced.
lina: OK looks like a revert is the right short-term move. propose: revert PR 14388, run canary, add a microbench guard for kv hitrate and a unit test that simulates high-seq_len workloads.
david: +1 on guard. also add telemetry for prefetch-issued-count so we can alert before hitrate drops.
anya: i'll open a revert PR now and include a follow-up to iterate on the prefetch window (safer defaults + simulated pressure).
chris: thanks — i'm going to file a rollout-blocker ticket and link perf diffs. ticket: https://issues.redwood/RT-2911
deploy-bot: revert branch build queued: https://ci.redwood/ci/14401 — will run microbench battery.
ben: after revert and canary pass, we should add a regression test in CI that runs kv_coldpath_bench on release images to catch this class.
lina: agreed. also add a PR checklist item: "run kv_coldpath microbench locally for changes touching prefetch/batcher/kernel_selector".
chris: noted. i'll coordinate the revert PR + canary deploy. thanks all :thumbsup:
maria: one more note — kernel_selector had a tiny change to scoring weights in the same PR; even if prefetch is root cause, we should split weight tuning into its own flag to A/B.
david: noted, will help instrument.
anya: revert PR opened: https://ci.redwood/pull/14402 (title: revert: adapt-prefetch heuristic revert).
chris: leaving this thread open until canary results in ~1 hour. ping me if you see new regressions. :eyes:
